sourceFile: 5. BRS-161016 DT Report test material MG-C have abnormal surface of Baotou supplier date 05.09.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Comparable evidence exists, but the draft misgroups the changed factor and corrupts key measurement outcomes.
issues: Changed factor is polluted with metrics and headers instead of abnormal Baotou Test MG-C vs Normal MG-C.
Baseline supplier context is inconsistently captured, especially Ruijin normal in Gauss section.
Measurement extraction is unreliable, mixing tension, Gauss, specs, dates, and sample numbers.
Gauss semi-yoke NG result and final can-not-use conclusion are not properly represented.
Several outcome domains and metrics are generic or mislabeled.
correctionPlan: Set primary factor to abnormal-surface Baotou Test MG-C versus Normal MG-C, with supplier context where cited.
Rebuild decap, tension, Gauss, and function as outcomes under the same validation report.
Reparse measurement tables using correct headers, specs, units, and paired Test/Normal rows.
Add cited final judgement rows and align outcome judgements with report conclusions.
Remove header/sample-number artifacts from subgroup keys and measurement stats.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are not sufficient until corrected rows support each grouped factor and outcome.
